## Status integrity

## Validation

List the exact validation performed for this head revision.

- [ ] Documentation links and repository structure checked when affected.
- [ ] Tests/checks applicable to this change passed.
- [ ] Privacy impact reviewed when personal media, metadata, faces, location, search, sharing, or intelligence are affected.
- [ ] Security impact reviewed when ingestion, storage, authentication, authorization, sharing, processing, or administration are affected.
- [ ] Recovery/portability impact reviewed when originals, authoritative metadata, deletion, backup, restore, migration, or export are affected.
- [ ] Glaze UI and accessibility impact reviewed for user-facing changes.
- [ ] Platform Contract declaration reconciled when lifecycle, interfaces, dependencies, or platform integrations changed.
